EP.name: Parameters.E
EP.statement: def E := CyclotomicField (P.N₁ s) P.K deriving Field, Algebra P.K, NumberField

pin.name: Parameters.placeOfInt
pin.statement: def placeOfInt ν := if h : IsUnit (Int.cast ν) then (P.placeMulEquiv s).symm h.unit else 1

pcl.name: Parameters.placeClass
pcl.statement: def placeClass {s m} (d : m ∣ P.N₁ s) := (ZMod.unitsMap d).comp (P.placeMulEquiv s).toMonoidHom

CP.name: Parameters.c
CP.statement:
def Parameters.c P := (exists_isJetConjugate_generator P).choose + (2 * P.d + 6) +
  (P.N₀ + |chowlaSelbergConst P.d| + ∑ w ∈ primitiveRoots
  P.N₀ ℂ, |‖(Polynomial.cyclotomic P.N₀ ℂ).derivative.eval w‖.log|)

Data.name: Data
Data.statement:
structure Data (P : Parameters) where
  /-- `logX = log x`, `logB = log b`, `logX₁ = log x₁`: the sizes are chosen on the logarithmic
  scale. -/
  (logX logB logX₁ : ℝ) (s m r : ℕ) s_le : s ≤ 32 * logX
  thick : Finset _
  g : Fin 2 → ℕ
  piG : 𝓞 P.K
  scale : 1e12 * P.c ≤ log logB ∧ 100 * log logB ≤ logX ∧ 1e6 * logX ≤ logX₁ ∧ 1e6 * logX₁ ≤ logB ∧
    6 * log logX₁ ≤ log logB
  m_mem : ↑m ∈ Icc (exp (logX / 2)) (2 * exp (logX / 2))
  r_mem : ↑r ∈ Icc (exp (5 * logX)) (3 * exp (5 * logX))
  m_pow : ∃ e, m = 2 ^ (e + 1) ∧ s = (e + 1) * 22
  r_pow : ∃ e, r = 3 ^ (e + 1)
  thick_eq_neg_one_mod {m} (d : m ∣ P.N₁ s) : m ∣ P.N₀ * 3 ^ (.log 3 s + 5) → ∀ σ ∈ thick, P.placeClass d σ = -1
  three_term : let φ := P.placeClass P.two_pow_dvd_N₁; ∀ i j, 0 < i → i < j → j ≤ 324 * s →
         ∀ σ ∈ thick, ∀ τ ∈ thick, ∀ ρ ∈ thick, φ (τ / σ) ^ j = φ (ρ / σ) ^ i → φ (τ / σ) = 1
  g_prime i : (g i).Prime
  g_modEq_one i : g i ≡ 1 [MOD P.N₁ s * P.d]
  dvd_g_sub_one i : P.Mω s ^ 2 ∣ g i - 1
  g_injective : g.Injective
  g_mem i : ↑(g i) ∈ Icc (exp logB ^ 10) (exp logB ^ 11)
  norm_piG : piG * star piG = g 0 * g 1
  exists_prime_window : ∀ U ∈ Icc (100 * logB) (2 ^ s), ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ p ≡ 1 [MOD P.Mω s ^ 2] ∧
    log p ∈ Icc U (U + √logB)

ED.name: Data.E
ED.statement: @[reducible] def E := P.E D.s deriving NumberField, CharZero, IsCMField

tops.name: Data.tops
tops.statement: def tops : Finset D.Φ := {τ | P.placeClass (P.N₀.dvd_mul_right _) τ = 1}

gD.name: Data.gProd
gD.statement: def gProd := D.g 0 * D.g 1 deriving NeZero

wt.name: Data.w
wt.statement: def w (σ : D.Φ) := ite (σ ∈ D.thick) D.b₁ D.b₂ + j * D.h + D.h₂

nw.name: Data.nominalWeight
nw.statement: def nominalWeight (σ : D.Φ) := D.a / ite (σ ∈ D.thick) D.x D.x₁

Ask.name: Data.primeSum
Ask.statement:
def primeSum σ := ∑ ν ∈ .Icc 1 D.a,
  lambdaClass P.d 1 ν * (y / ν - D.nominalWeight (D.placeOfInt (-ν) * σ))⁺

jet.name: Data.jetSize
jet.statement: def jetSize := log (Nat.factorial j) - j * (P.bigOmega D.s / D.gProd).log

UD.name: Data.dirCost
UD.statement: def dirCost := ∑ σ, (D.jetSize (D.w 0 σ) - D.primeSum (D.nominalWeight σ) σ)

hlb.name: Data.HasLogBound
hlb.statement:
class HasLogBound (D : Data P) (u : Bool) F (l :
  outParam ℝ) where out : ite u (|F| ≤ exp l) (exp l ≤ F)

upabs.name: Data.hasLogUpper_of_abs_le
upabs.statement: lemma hasLogUpper_of_abs_le : |G| ≤ F → D.HasLogUpper G l

upnonneg.name: Data.hasLogUpper_of_le_of_nonneg
upnonneg.statement:
lemma hasLogUpper_of_le_of_nonneg (e : G ≤ F) (h : 0 ≤ G := by positivity) :
  D.HasLogUpper G l

upnat.name: Data.hasLogUpper_of_le
upnat.statement: lemma hasLogUpper_of_le : B ≤ A → D.HasLogUpper B l

lowle.name: Data.hasLogLower_of_le
lowle.statement: lemma hasLogLower_of_le : G ≤ F → D.HasLogLower F l'

icc.name: Data.HasLogBound.of_mem_Icc
icc.statement:
lemma HasLogBound.of_mem_Icc {l} (G H := F) [D.HasLogLower G l] [D.HasLogUpper H l'] (e :
  F ∈ Icc G H := by simp) (a : ite u (l' ≤ c)
  (c ≤ l) := by cases u <;> grind [D.scale]) : HasLogBound D u F c

natcast.name: Data.hasLogBound_natCast
natcast.statement:
instance (priority := low) hasLogBound_natCast [NeZero A] :
  HasLogBound D u A (ite u A 0)

bdmul.name: Data.hasLogBound_mul
bdmul.statement: instance hasLogBound_mul : HasLogBound D u (F * G) (l + l')

bdadd.name: Data.hasLogBound_add
bdadd.statement: instance hasLogBound_add : HasLogBound D u (F + G) (max l l' + ite u 1 0)

bdf.name: Data.hasLogBound_f
bdf.statement: instance hasLogBound_f : HasLogBound D u D.f (11 * D.logX + ite u (D.logB.log / 5 + P.c) 0)

cge.name: Data.c_ge
cge.statement: lemma c_ge : 64 ≤ P.c ∧ P.N₀ ≤ P.c ∧ P.d ≤ P.c ∧ φ P.N₀ ≤ P.c

round.name: Data.roundUp_mem_Icc
round.statement: lemma roundUp_mem_Icc [D.HasLogLower F l] : ↑(D.roundUp F) ∈ Icc F (F + D.N₁)

clthick.name: Data.placeClass_of_thick
clthick.statement: lemma placeClass_of_thick : ∀ σ ∈ D.thick, P.placeClass ⟨_, rfl⟩ σ = -1

nwicc.name: Data.nominalWeight_mem_Icc
nwicc.statement:
lemma nominalWeight_mem_Icc :
  D.nominalWeight σ ∈ Icc (D.a / D.x₁) (D.a / D.x)

nwadd.name: Data.nominalWeight_add_le
nwadd.statement: lemma nominalWeight_add_le : D.nominalWeight σ + D.x ^ 42 ≤ 2 * D.b

nwlew.name: Data.nominalWeight_le_w_sub
nwlew.statement:
lemma nominalWeight_le_w_sub j σ : D.nominalWeight σ ≤
  D.w j σ - D.h₂

wlenw.name: Data.w_le_nominalWeight_add
wlenw.statement: lemma w_le_nominalWeight_add : D.w j σ ≤ D.nominalWeight σ + D.x ^ 42

wletwob.name: Data.w_le_two_mul_b
wletwob.statement:
lemma w_le_two_mul_b :
  D.w j σ ≤ 2 * D.b

logw.name: Data.log_w_le
logw.statement: lemma log_w_le : log (D.w j σ) ≤ log (D.nominalWeight σ) + D.x⁻¹

chequiv.name: Data.chosenEquiv
chequiv.statement:
def chosenEquiv : D.Φ ≃ D.ChosenPlace i :=
  (Parameters.nonempty_infinitePlace_equiv_finPlace (g_modEq_one ..) D.exists_cofactor).some

prodq.name: Data.prod_q_chosenPlace
prodq.statement: lemma prod_q_chosenPlace : ∏ x, (D.chosen x).q = D.gProd ^ D.f

chstar.name: Data.isChosen_star_iff
chstar.statement: lemma isChosen_star_iff {i} : ↑(D.g i) ∈ w.1 → (D.IsChosen (star w) ↔ ¬D.IsChosen w)

valN.name: Data.v_N_eq_exp_neg_one
valN.statement: lemma v_N_eq_exp_neg_one (h : ↑D.N ∈ w.1) : Valued.v (D.N : LocField w) = .exp (-1)

valpi.name: Data.intValuation_pi
valpi.statement: lemma intValuation_pi (h : D.π ∈ w.1) : w.intValuation D.π = .exp (-1)

ordch.name: Data.chosenGroupOrder
ordch.statement: def chosenGroupOrder := Nat.card (∀ x, GL (Fin (D.r * D.t)) (ResField (D.chosen x))) deriving NeZero

cardGL.name: Data.card_GL_dvd_chosenGroupOrder
cardGL.statement:
lemma card_GL_dvd_chosenGroupOrder (h : Fintype.card n ≤ D.r * D.t) :
  .card (∀ x, GL n (ResField (D.chosen x))) ∣ D.chosenGroupOrder

princ.name: Data.principalLevel_le_chosenLevel
princ.statement: lemma principalLevel_le_chosenLevel {a} (h : D.piGBar ∣ a) : principalLevel n a ≤ D.chosenLevel

neat.name: Data.classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel
neat.statement:
lemma classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel (hK : K ≤ chosenLevel) (h : Fintype.card n ≤ 2 * D.n D.m) :
  ∀ g, classAut stdRatPoints K g = ⊥

mink.name: Data.card_classAut_dvd_chosenGroupOrder
mink.statement:
lemma card_classAut_dvd_chosenGroupOrder (hn : Fintype.card n ≤ 2 * D.n D.m) (hK : K ≤ Kf _ n) g :
    .card (classAut stdRatPoints K g) ∣ D.chosenGroupOrder

omega.name: Data.omega_zpow_ne_one
omega.statement:
lemma omega_zpow_ne_one (n : ℤ) (h : n ≠ 0 ∧ n.natAbs ≤ 8 * D.m := by omega) w : (D.ω ^ n) w ≠ 1 ↔
  D.IsChosen w

behrend.name: exists_three_term_free
behrend.statement:
lemma exists_three_term_free {G H} [CommGroup G] [CommGroup H] (φ : G →* H) c g (n M L : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (h : (L * M) ^ n ≤ orderOf (φ g)) : ∃ T, (∀ σ ∈ T, ∃ e, σ = c * g ^ e) ∧
    (M ^ n / (n * M ^ 2) : ℝ) ≤ #T ∧ ∀ i j, 0 < i → i < j → j ≤ L → ∀ σ ∈ T, ∀ τ ∈ T, ∀ ρ ∈ T, φ
    (τ / σ) ^ j = φ (ρ / σ) ^ i → φ (τ / σ) = 1

pigeon.name: exists_mul_principal
pigeon.statement:
lemma exists_mul_principal {K} [Field K] [NumberField K] {I J : Fin (classNumber K + 1) → FinPlace
  K} (H : ∀ i, ((I i).1 * (J i).1).IsPrincipal) : ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ ((I i).1 * (J j).1).IsPrincipal

exdata.name: exists_data
exdata.statement:
lemma exists_data P {ε : ℝ} (e0 : 0 < ε / 6) (e1 : ε < 1 / 100) : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, ∃ D : Data P,
    D.x = x ∧ log D.x₁ = x ^ (ε / 6) ∧ (1e6 * log x) ^ 2 ≤ log D.x₁ ∧
    log (log D.b) = ε * log x ∧ towerDeg D.s / log D.b ≤ #D.thick
